title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum credited directly to bank account via DBT in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each.
documents_required: Active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization care to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled hospitals.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas to construct pucca houses.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP districts, plus 90-95 days of MGNREGS wage employment.

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.
benefits: Skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 tool kit incentive, collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional 5% interest rate.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small deposit savings scheme for the girl child launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign offering attractive interest rates and tax exemptions.
benefits: High compound interest (8.2%+ p.a.), Section 80C tax deduction, tax-free maturity amount for girl's higher education and marriage.
documents_required: Identity and Address Proof of Guardian (Aadhaar/PAN)

title: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed monthly pension scheme for all unorganized sector workers upon reaching 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 per month based on contribution amount.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Legal guarantee for at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment at statutory state wage rates; unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Direct maternity benefit cash incentive for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second living child (if second is girl).
benefits: ₹5,000 in two installments for first child; ₹6,000 in single installment for second girl child.

excluded_categories: Regular employees of Central/State Govt or PSUs
